title: Sites
description: Build custom pages connected to your tables.
starterText: Start here. Edit the files, or ask an agent to design the page around your needs.
emptyDescription: Build registration pages, branded forms or knowledge portals backed by your tables. You can also ask an agent with the site skill to create one.
createDescription: Create a site, then edit the page or ask an agent to help.
name: Site name
deleteDescription: Source files and version history will be deleted. The public link will stop working immediately.
previewFailed: Preview failed. Check the files and refresh.
invalidPath: Enter a valid relative path. HTML, CSS, JS, JSON, SVG and text files are supported.
duplicatePath: This file path already exists or conflicts with a directory.
historyDescription: Select a version to inspect its files and preview.
fileDescription: Use a relative path, such as assets/styles.css.
dataDescription: The key will be visible in the public page. Grant only the table read/create operations needed. Configure field bindings in your page code.
publishDescription: Publish version {{n}} at this address. Anyone with the link can visit.
deleteFileDescription: Remove {{path}} from the draft. Save to apply. Previous versions retain the file.
discardDescription: Discard unsaved changes and load the current saved version from the server.
